about: Rune Vault sandbox seed. Stock vaults come from shipped templates; the fixture supplies two runesets, one-off and pinned-text rules, and a skill to remove in a variant.

cases.3: locked skill edit offers variant and preserves the original
cases.5: Custom copies two runesets and one rune over the stock floor
cases.6: Lock button before the first message
cases.7: stock-codex floor, first-message lock and vault source
cases.8: Generate adds to a vault without row or gen-index artifacts
cases.9: WebView restart re-adopts the locked session with its original vault pin
cases.10: library text edit leaves the locked revision and DOM text pinned with drift
cases.11: Delete Rune and Delete Library remove runes-e2e-del with backups and leave vaults and pins unchanged
cases.12: rune trays inset evenly and an open card's border keeps its hue
